entry.title: Joule + M365 Copilot (Teams): can standard transactions run, and are custom Skills / Agent Gateway r
entry.content:
Situation

Following the SAP Help Portal guide "Using Joule with Microsoft 365 Copilot," I integrated Joule with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Teams) and can use Joule from Teams. Q&A works, but transactional requests (e.g., viewing a sales order) do not: Joule replies that, due to system limitations, it cannot access real-time data / APIs and offers manual steps instead. The same happens in the Joule Web Client (Fiori) as well.

Viewing sales orders is listed as a standard Joule transactional capability (Viewing Business Data), yet it won't execute — even after I confirmed the integration, content sync, and the required display authorizations are all in place.

Questions

  1. Standard transactions like viewing sales orders are officially supported, so does this response mean the capability just isn't activated in this landscape? If so, what is needed to enable transactional execution here?
  2. Through the Teams / M365 Copilot integration, are only built-in capabilities available, or can custom Skills / Agents built in Joule Studio also be triggered from Teams? (Microsoft's docs say Copilot Studio custom agents aren't routed, but it's unclear whether Joule Studio ones are.)
  3. If custom transactional Skills / Agents can't be triggered via the Teams add-in, what's the recommended way to launch them from Teams (e.g., via Agent Gateway, once available)?

Environment

SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition; Joule × M365 Copilot (Teams) and Joule Web Client (Fiori); auth via Microsoft Entra ID ⇔ SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS).

entry.title: 3 Tier Unified Joule Landscape with existing 3 tier SuccessFactors / IAS Landscape
entry.content:
We are looking at the best architecture for our usage of Unified Joule and SAP AI. We have recently implemented SuccessFactors (SF) and have started on our transformation journey from ECC to S/4HANA PCE.  As part of our SF deployment we now have an SAP Identity tenant aligned to each tier of our SF environment (3 tier, dev/test/prod) as per standard SAP.

When we look at the SAP Joule Landscape recommendation in the SAP Architecture Centre basically all of the recommended architecture only reference a prod and a non-prod IAS tenant. To establish this would require us breaking the standard SAP 1:1 relationship between SF and IAS.

Rather then doing this we are wondering whether establishing the Joule landscape by adding to the existing landscape and still utilise the three IAS tenants across the three tiers.

Are there any thoughts/comments/issues with taking this approach?

SAP Joule Landscape Recommendation

 


Proposed 3 tier Joule Landscape adding to the existing BTP/IAS/SF Environments

entry.title: SAP Joule Agent Skill Calling BPA API Trigger Returns Intermittent Null Response
entry.content:
Hi Community,

I am experiencing an intermittent issue with an SAP Joule Agent that invokes an SAP Build Process Automation (BPA) process through a deployed API Trigger.

Scenario

  • SAP Joule Agent and BPA process are deployed in the same environment.
  • The Agent calls the BPA API Trigger using a Skill.
  • When I test the API Trigger directly (outside the Agent), it consistently works and returns the expected response.
  • However, when the same API Trigger is called from the Joule Agent Skill, the behavior is inconsistent:
    • Sometimes the response is returned correctly.
    • Sometimes the Skill receives a null response for the exact same input payload.
Has anyone experienced intermittent null responses when Joule Agents invoke BPA API Triggers?

entry.title: Joule extension fails to install on BTP Trial (BAS) — 401 from internal registry (Bearer auth)
entry.content:
Hello,

I am using SAP Build Code on an SAP BTP Trial account in the US10 trial region. When starting my Full-Stack Node.js dev space, several SAP extensions fail to install, including Joule, BAS tools, Yeoman UI, Service Center MCP, and other dependencies.Errors

The installation log starts with:

FW ERROR: You are currently using "Bearer" authentication. Only Basic and JWT authentications are supported.

Then requests to SAP's internal registry fail with HTTP 401, for example:

GET https://common.repositories.cloud.sap/artifactory/api/npm/devx-npm-live/@bas-dev%2fbas-cli - 401

GET https://common.repositories.cloud.sap/artifactory/api/npm/devx-npm-live/@bas-dev%2fservice-center-mcp - 401

Joule also fails with:

FW ERROR: The @SAP-buildcode/joule failed to install because tarballUrl.lastIndexOf is not a function.

I have already:

  • Deleted and recreated the dev space
  • Stopped and restarted the dev space several times
  • Signed out and signed back in
  • Tested from a clean browser session
  • Verified the required SAP Build Code / BAS / HANA role collections
  • Confirmed that some public packages such as CDS, CAP MCP, Fiori MCP and UI5 MCP install successfully

However, packages retrieved from common.repositories.cloud.sap continue to return HTTP 401.

It appears that the BAS extension provisioning process is receiving an invalid authentication type/token for SAP's internal repository.

Is this a known issue with SAP BTP Trial / US10, or is there anything that can be reset or reprovisioned for my trial account?

Thank you.

entry.title: Can Joule consume S4HANA Cloud Public Edition SAC Embedded Reports
entry.content:
Hello ,

We are currently evaluating the use of Joule in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition and would like to clarify the analytical capabilities available when Joule is used directly within S/4HANA Public.

Our scenario is the following:

  • We are using SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.
  • Joule is already enabled and available within our S/4HANA system.
  • We are using SAP Analytics Cloud Embedded within the same S/4HANA Public Cloud system.
  • We have created Embedded SAC Story Reports directly in S/4HANA Public Cloud (not standalone SAC Stories in an independent SAP Analytics Cloud tenant).
  • These Stories are based on S/4HANA Custom CDS Views / Analytical Queries.

For example, we have an Embedded SAC Story showing Supply Chain & Finance KPIs such as:

  • Total Stock Value
  • Stock Value by Plant
  • Number of Storage Locations with Stock
  • Stock Quantity
  • etc.

When the user opens the same S/4HANA system and asks Joule questions such as:

"What is the total Stock Value?"

or

"What is the Stock Value for Plant X?"

Joule is currently unable to provide the corresponding analytical values.

We would therefore like to clarify the following:

1. Can Joule in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition consume/analyze data directly from Custom CDS Views and/or Custom Analytical Queries created in the same S/4HANA Public Cloud system?

2. Can Joule consume the data from an Embedded SAP Analytics Cloud Story created directly in S/4HANA Public Cloud?

3. If the answer is yes, what configuration is required to make these CDS Views / Embedded SAC analytical content available to Joule?

In particular, we would like to understand whether Joule Analytical Insights supports this Embedded SAC scenario and whether the underlying CDS View / Analytical Query needs to be indexed or exposed through Just Ask.

4. If the Embedded SAC Story itself cannot be consumed by Joule, is there a supported way to expose the underlying CDS View / Analytical Query to Joule so that Joule can answer the same analytical questions and return the same KPI values shown in the Embedded SAC Story?

We are specifically looking for a supported SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition architecture where:

S/4HANA CDS View → Embedded SAC Story → Joule

or, alternatively:

S/4HANA CDS View / Analytical Query → Joule Analytical Insights

can be used to provide conversational access to the same analytical data.

Could you please confirm whether this scenario is supported and, if so, provide the relevant configuration/documentation or the required setup steps?

Thank you.

entry.title: Joule Studio agent deployment fails with "Tenant Administration Worker - 6002" and HTTP 500.
entry.content:
Hi everyone,

We are experiencing deployment issues in SAP Build Joule Studio (classic edition) and are trying to determine the root cause.

Issue

When deploying a Joule agent, deployment fails with errors similar to:

Create agent request failed with status code 500
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
Tenant Administration Worker - 6002

We also receive a warning stating:

 
An intermittent issue with Joule is currently preventing the role check.​

What we have already verified

  • AI Agent Builder Activation is enabled.
  • The user has the extensibility_developer role.
  • The deployment environment exists and is selectable.
  • Previously working versions of the same agent now fail as well.
  • Re-deploying older versions (which deployed successfully in the past) results in the same error.

Because even historical working versions are failing, we are starting to suspect a tenant or platform-related issue rather than an issue with the agent itself.

Question

Has anyone seen deployment failures with Tenant Administration Worker - 6002 before?

Could exhausted AI Units, AI Core quotas, or other AI-related entitlements cause this type of deployment failure, or would a different error typically be expected in that scenario?

Any guidance on where to investigate next would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks!

entry.title: Is embedding the Joule Web Client into a partner-built SAPUI5 app supported?
entry.content:
Hi all,

we are an SAP partner. Our SAPUI5 product is deployed into each customer's own BTP Cloud Foundry subaccount and served by a standalone approuter. No SAP Build Work Zone, no Fiori launchpad, no HTML5 Application Repository, XSUAA-based authentication. Customers who would use Joule hold the Joule entitlement themselves through their own SAP cloud solution.

We would like to make Joule available inside our UI. What we found so far:

  • Integrating Joule into Applications Using Custom Domains documents adding the custom domain of a "parent application" to the trusted domains of the Joule subaccount, using the generic example store.example.com
  • The Supported Browsers page states that the Joule Web Client runs in an iframe and explicitly covers the case of "applications having a domain other than the SAP product domain cloud.sap or its subdomains".

My questions:

  1. Is the custom-domain / trusted-domain mechanism intended only for SAP-delivered applications, or may the "parent application" be a customer- or partner-built application?
  2. If embedding is possible at all: is there a documented way to load the Web Client into a host application, or is the only supported launch point an SAP product shell / SAP Build Work Zone site?

I am not looking for a workaround! I want to know what is supported, so we can decide whether to build on it or on Joule Studio capabilities instead.

Thanks!

entry.title: SBPA deploy fails 3 weeks: Integration Gateway returns 500 compiling all projects
entry.content:
Hi all,

For roughly three weeks we have been unable to reliably deploy any SAP Build Process Automation project. An incident is open with SAP support but has not progressed, so I am posting here in case others are seeing the same behavior or know of a workaround.

ERROR

When deploying any project, the deployment fails with:

"The project (ID: <project id>, version: X.Y.Z) in the environment (ID: <env>) could not be deployed."

More details: "Errors occurred while deploying an artifact to a runtime. (component: Integration Gateway)"

Followed by a list of: "Compilation failed for project <project id>: Request failed with status code 500"

The listed projects are unrelated to the one being deployed. The error enumerates many other projects in the tenant, all failing compilation at the same time with the same 500.

In one case the dialog itself stated: "An error occurred in the Integration Gateway during agent compilation. Please use the Copy Error Details button to copy the error information and include it when opening a support ticket (SNOW)."

WHAT WE HAVE ALREADY RULED OUT

- Not specific to one project: fails on several existing projects deployed in isolation.

- Not specific to project content: fails on a brand-new project containing a single trivial Condition step.

- Not specific to Joule Studio: fails equally on a plain Process Automation project with no Skill or Joule artifact.

- Not specific to one environment: reproduced in both a Shared Environment and a Private Environment.

- Not specific to deployment: the same failure occurs when running Test.

- Not specific to region: we created a brand-new subaccount in EU10 and the failure reproduces there as well.

- Not an Agent version issue: Agent version 3.44.

- Design Console reports 0 errors in all cases.

OBSERVED PATTERN

The first release and deploy early in the morning generally succeeds. After that, every subsequent deploy on the same day fails with the above error, consistently, including re-deploying an already released version with no changes at all.

QUESTIONS

1. Is anyone else currently seeing Integration Gateway returning 500 during project compilation?

2. Is there any known workaround beyond retrying?

3. Is it expected that deploying one project triggers recompilation of every other project in the environment? If so, is there a way to limit that scope?

Any pointers appreciated. Happy to provide correlation IDs and full error details.

Thanks.

Since I currently lack the necessary system connections and data access for this specific query, I cannot display the list directly.
